blocks.heading: B.tech B.E Degree
rows: B.Tech / B.E. degree
Check
Needs Maths in Class 12. A diploma can lead to second-year lateral entry; verify the state and college.
Scalable with a business layer. Crowded as a degree alone; scales with product, automation or AI skills.
MBBS, BDS and NEET medical seats
Needs Biology in Class 12 with NEET UG.
Not so scalable. Competition at several levels (NEET, postgraduate seats, practice) with few seats; effort alone may not lead to a seat.
CA, CMA, CS professional courses
Check
Check
Open to every stream after Class 12; commerce subjects make the first exams easier.
A practice can grow into advisory work, but the exam ladder is long and crowded.
Law (integrated 5-year)
Check
Check
Entry tests such as CLAT and CUET take students from any stream after Class 12.
Not so scalable. Entrance competition, then a slow climb where few reach the top.
Design degrees
Check
Check
Design entrance tests usually accept any stream; the portfolio carries the weight.
Scalable. Portfolio and skill decide pay; freelance and studio paths are open.
BBA, B.Com, BMS
Check
Check
Most accept any stream; some want Maths or Accountancy. Check each college.
A general degree is crowded, but it is a natural base for a venture or consulting practice with a domain skill.

blocks.heading: Official Source Before You Pay
rows: NIOS (open schooling)

Open-school Secondary and Senior Secondary, vocational courses, study centres. The site states that the Association of Indian Universities has issued equivalence for the NIOS Senior Secondary certificate.
DGT Craftsmen Training Scheme (ITI)
How the ITI network works. The page lists 14,643 ITIs and 169 NSQF-compliant trades (checked October 2026).
NATS (apprenticeship training)
Apprenticeship-style, learn-while-working training for diploma and technical graduates.
AICTE
Check that a diploma or engineering institute is approved before paying.
NTA (JEE Main, NEET UG, CUET UG)
Exam eligibility, syllabus and dates for the entrance tests that start after Class 12.

blocks.heading: Mistakes Families Make with a Career Chart

items.text: Choosing by marks alone.
Copying friends or relatives.
Dropping Maths or Biology without checking.
Paying before verifying.
Treating the route as the whole plan.
Download the PDF for your stream and write the route you lean toward, and a second route you would accept, on the plan page.
Check your lean.
Finish one small real task that resembles the route, then explain it to someone who does that work.
Verify the rules for your state and the institute on the official sources below.
